name: feastcloud
description: Open-source, offline-first Food and Kitchen Operating System

scripts.check: npm run contracts:validate && npm run licenses:node && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run licenses:go && npm run go:test && npm run go:vet && npm run smoke:connected && npm run smoke:postgres
scripts.licenses:check: npm run licenses:node && npm run licenses:go
scripts.security:core: cd services/core && GOWORK=off go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.6.0 ./...
scripts.security:edge: cd services/edge && GOWORK=off go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.6.0 ./...
scripts.security:go: npm run security:core && npm run security:edge
scripts.security:check: npm run security:node && npm run security:go
scripts.sbom:web: mkdir -p dist/sbom && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx > dist/sbom/web.cdx.json
scripts.sbom:core: mkdir -p dist/sbom && cd services/core && GOWORK=off go run github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-gomod/cmd/cyclonedx-gomod@v1.10.0 mod -json -licenses -output ../../dist/sbom/core.cdx.json
scripts.sbom:edge: mkdir -p dist/sbom && cd services/edge && GOWORK=off go run github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-gomod/cmd/cyclonedx-gomod@v1.10.0 mod -json -licenses -output ../../dist/sbom/edge.cdx.json
scripts.sbom: npm run sbom:web && npm run sbom:core && npm run sbom:edge
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run security:check && npm run sbom
